verses.en: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.pt: Depois disto Davi derrotou os filisteus, e os subjugou e tomou das mãos deles Gate e as suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about after this that David made an attack on the Philistines and overcame them, and took Gath with its daughter-towns out of the hands of the Philistines.

verses.en: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.
verses.pt: Também derrotou os moabitas, e estes lhe ficaram sujeitos, pagando-lhe tributos.
verses.en_web: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
verses.en_bbe: And he overcame Moab, and the Moabites became his servants and gave him offerings.

verses.en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.pt: Davi derrotou também Hadadézer, rei de Zobá, junto a Hamate, quando foi estabelecer o seu domínio junto ao rio Eufrates.
verses.en_web: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah to Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.en_bbe: Then David overcame Hadadezer, king of Zobah, near Hamath, when he was going to make his power seen by the river Euphrates.

verses.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
verses.pt: E Davi lhe tomou mil carros, sete mil cavaleiros e vinte mil homens de infantaria; e jarretou todos os cavalos dos carros; porém reservou deles para cem carros.
verses.en_web: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.
verses.en_bbe: And David took from him a thousand war-carriages and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand footmen: and he had the leg-muscles of all the horses cut, keeping only enough of them for a hundred war-carriages.

verses.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.pt: E quando os sírios de Damasco vieram para ajudar a Hadadézer, rei de Zobá, Davi matou deles vinte e dois mil homens.
verses.en_web: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.
verses.en_bbe: And when the Aramaeans of Damascus came to the help of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, David put to the sword twenty-two thousand Aramaeans.

verses.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.pt: Então Davi pôs guarnições entre os sírios de Damasco, e os sirios lhe ficaram sujeitos, pagando-lhe tributos; e o Senhor dava vitória a Davi, por onde quer que ia.
verses.en_web: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.en_bbe: Then David put armed forces in Damascus, and the Aramaeans became his servants and gave him offerings. And the Lord made David overcome wherever he went.

verses.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Davi tomou os escudos de ouro que tinham sido dos servos de Hadadézer, e os trouxe a Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And the gold body-covers of the servants of Hadadezer, David took to Jerusalem.

verses.en: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.pt: Também de Tibate, e de Cum, cidades de Hadadézer, Davi tomou muitíssimo bronze, de que Salomão fez o mar de bronze, as colunas, e os utensílios de bronze.
verses.en_web: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much brass, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.en_bbe: And from Tibhath and from Cun, towns of Hadadezer, David took a great store of brass, of which Solomon made the great brass water-vessel and the brass pillars and vessels.

verses.en: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
verses.pt: Ora, quando Toú, rei de Hamate, ouviu que Davi destruíra todo o exército de Hadadézer, rei de Zobá,
verses.en_web: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
verses.en_bbe: Now when Tou, king of Hamath, had news that David had overcome all the army of Hadadezer, king of Zobah,

verses.en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.pt: mandou seu filho Hadorão ao rei Davi, para o saudar, e para o felicitar por haver pelejado contra Hadadézer e por tê-lo destruído (porque Hadadézer fazia guerra a Toú). Enviou-lhe também toda sorte de utensílios de ouro, de prata e de bronze. l
verses.en_web: he sent Hadoram his son to king David, to Greet him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.en_bbe: He sent his son Hadoram to King David, to give him words of peace and blessing, because he had overcome Hadadezer in the fight, for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou; and he gave him all sorts of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

verses.en: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.pt: A estes também o rei Davi consagrou ao Senhor, juntamente com a prata e o ouro que trouxera de todas as nações dos edomeus, dos moabitas, dos amonitas, dos filisteus e dos amalequitas.
verses.en_web: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations; from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.en_bbe: These King David made holy to the Lord, together with the silver and gold he had taken from all nations; from Edom and Moab and from the children of Ammon and from the Philistines and from Amalek.

verses.en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
verses.pt: Além disso Abisai, filho de Zeruia, matou dezoito mil edomeus no Vale do Sal.
verses.en_web: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.en_bbe: And when he came back from putting to the sword eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt,

verses.en: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.pt: E pôs guarnições em Edom, e todos os edomeus ficaram sujeitos a Davi; e o Senhor dava vitória a Davi, por onde quer que ia.
verses.en_web: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.en_bbe: David put armed forces in all the towns of Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The Lord made David overcome wherever he went.

verses.en: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
verses.pt: Dari, pois, reinou sobre todo o Israel; e julgava, e fazia justiça a todo o seu povo.
verses.en_web: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
verses.en_bbe: So David was king over all Israel, judging and giving right decisions for all his people.

verses.en: And Joab the son Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
verses.pt: Joabe, filho de Zeruia, tinha o cargo do exército; Jeosafá, filho de Ailude, era cronista;
verses.en_web: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.en_bbe: And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the army; and Jehoshaphat, son of Ahilud, was keeper of the records.

verses.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.pt: Zadoque, filho de Aiuube, e Abimeleque, filho de Abiatar, eram sacerdotes; Sarsa era escrivão;
verses.en_web: Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; Shavsha was scribe;
verses.en_bbe: And Zadok, the son of Ahitub; and Ahimelech, the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Shavsha was the scribe;

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.pt: Benaías, filho de Jeoiada, tinha o cargo dos quereteus e peleteus; e os filhos de Davi eram os primeiros junto ao rei.
verses.en_web: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.
verses.en_bbe: And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief of those whose places were at the king's side.
